about: The mod's Lua modules. Each one is a file in mod/RockAndStoneFrontier/Scripts.

rows.does: Logging, game clock, player/camera/keys, line traces, loading the DRG stats the extractor wrote
Finds enemies, probes health, applies damage with the first route that works and remembers it per enemy class
Builds the chosen class's loadout from the sheets plus DRG stats; ammo, clips, reloads, weapon swap
Fires hitscan, shotgun, stream and projectile weapons at the stats' fire rate
Grenades (flight, fuse, sticky, cryo freeze, explosion) and the Engineer's turret
Turns off Far Far West's own guns and spells and hides their props
Class picker at run start and the ammo/grenade/turret HUD
Wires everything to a 60 Hz game-thread loop and the run-start detection
